verdict.rationale: Digits documents real-time integrations with 12,000+ financial institutions, live connected financial data, and dashboards that update automatically as transactions sync, so automatic import from connected accounts is a first-party capability. The evidence does not document the founder-facing steps for linking bank accounts or credit cards specifically, or the sync cadence, and all of it is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented bank/credit-card account linking flow, explicit credit-card account support, stated daily or continuous sync cadence and reliability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: live dashboards that update automatically as transactions sync
